title: Localizations of Nagata rings are Nagata
statement: Let $A$ be a Nagata ring [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring] and let $T\subseteq A$ be a multiplicative subset. Then the localization $T^{-1}A$ is a Nagata ring: it is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and for every prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset T^{-1}A$ the domain $(T^{-1}A)/\mathfrak q$ is N-2 [def-weil-pbc-japanese-domain]. In particular each local ring $A_{\mathfrak p}$ and each principal localization $A_f$ is Nagata.
